name: Mildred Lee
bio: Richard Le Gallienne's first wife, who died in 1894 giving birth to their second daughter Maria, who died with her; their elder daughter Hesper Joyce survived. Le Gallienne afterwards carried an urn of her ashes with him everywhere, through his second marriage and beyond - a habit Rupert Brooke satirised in a poem, 'For Mildred's Urn'.
bio_note: NEITHER THE DATE NOR THE PLACE OF THIS MARRIAGE IS RECORDED ANYWHERE READ, and neither is her birth year. The article introduces her only as 'his first wife' at the point of her death. Nothing is reasoned backwards from the children's births and nothing is invented; the fields are left null. Not to be confused with Vernon Lee, who is a separate node on this map.
